newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador sees $457 mln profit from pipeline project.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador sees $457 mln profit from pipeline project.

text.p: The Ecuadorean state will make a profit of $457 million from the expansion of the trans-Ecuadorean oil pipeline, according to a government document Monday.

"The consolidated economic benefit which the state will obtain from the project is $457 million, which is the result of producing and transporting an additional 115 million barrels of oil," said a report produced by the state-controlled pipeline's management.
It added that the project will pay for itself in 1.1 years at current oil prices.
Ecuador hopes to conclude the $121 million project in early 1998, expanding the pipeline's capacity to 410,000 barrels a day from 330,000 barrels a day.
